config.name: apiKey
config.description: Your Apify API token for authenticated access. Get it from https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations. Required for data retrieval; optional for server discovery and capability listing.

tools.name: search_court_records
tools.description: Search public court records database by individual name, case number, or state jurisdiction. Returns case details including parties involved, case type (civil/criminal), filing date, judgment, and docket number. Use for background checks, legal research, or case tracking. Limited to public records.

params.name: name
params.description: Full name or partial name of person involved in case (e.g. 'John Smith', 'Jane Doe')

params.name: state
params.description: U.S. state or jurisdiction for search (e.g. 'CA', 'NY', 'Texas')

prompts.name: records_search
prompts.description: Search public court records by name or case number with jurisdiction filtering.

resources.name: Court Records Coverage
resources.description: Public court records across US state jurisdictions. Civil and criminal case search.
